title: Wreck and Horizon
author: Jude Lockridge
blurb: Felix Reyes, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the dry season ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
